solarTypes.title: Types of Solar Systems
solarTypes.description: Understand which solar installation type suits your home or business — with pros, cons, and best-use cases.

onGrid.title: On-Grid Solar
onGrid.description: Connected directly to the electricity grid. Excess power is exported back and you earn credits. Best for areas with stable grid supply. No battery required.
pros: Eligible for PM Surya Ghar subsidy

offGrid.title: Off-Grid Solar
offGrid.description: Fully independent from the electricity grid. Powered by solar panels + battery bank. Perfect for remote areas, farms, and places with poor grid supply.

hybrid.title: Hybrid Solar
hybrid.description: Combines on-grid and off-grid benefits. Uses solar first, stores extra in batteries, draws from grid when needed. Maximum flexibility and reliability.
